primary_meaning: Sudden, violent, complete, and irreversible destruction or divine judgment

alternatives.meaning: The power of faith (or believing prayer) to remove great obstacles or accomplish the impossible
Permanent removal and non-remembrance of sins

notes: The imagery of a stone, mountain, or millstone cast into the sea appears in multiple distinct scriptural contexts. Apocalyptic and judgment passages (especially the millstone) most frequently supply the destruction/judgment sense in Christian teaching, while the mountain-into-sea sayings supply a separate, widely taught faith motif; the two are not collapsed into one settled symbol.
